entities.name: Parnajom of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pharnajom or Pharnajob was a king (mepe) of Iberia from 109 to 90 BC, the fourth in the P'arnavaziani line. He is known exclusively from the royal list included in the medieval Georgian chronicles.
